title: Heavy work schedule: picnics, excursions, hotels
summary: After the first pavilion job he worked constantly, playing the lakefront, railroad excursions, picnics, the Blue Room and hotels.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Well, weren't you terribly tired? How'd you get any rest?

Well, I just, well, I, you see, when I would get my rest, I'd take a good one, you see? I really take a good one. So, after that, well, we started going all over. Play on the lake. The lakefront was open, you see? You have picnics and things. We play excursions, known for the railroad. And different things, like different picnics, kind of, you know, picnics, you know, like that. Like the holiday, like that. We play picnics all over. We play everywhere, you know what I mean? I played in all, I played in the Blue Room. I played in the Blue Room. I played in Mont Leon Hotel. I played in all them hotels.
